metadata.title: Monotonicity and evolution of total isoperimetric profiles under Minkowski regularization
metadata.abstract: We study the evolution of the total isoperimetric profile of a planar convex body under volume-preserving Minkowski regularization. Several scalar geometric quantities are known to be monotone along this flow; we prove that the total isoperimetric profile is monotone as well, and characterize the equality cases. We also establish an explicit reparametrization law, by which, for nonnegative times, the profile of the regularized body is determined by that of the initial one, and the order of profiles of bodies of equal area is preserved. As consequences, we obtain the uniform convergence of the profile to the one of the ball of equal area; its joint \(\mathrm C^1\) regularity in the volume and the regularization parameter; the fact that it solves a nonlocal quasilinear Hamilton--Jacobi equation; and sharp inequalities for the profile.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 研究平面凸体在保体积 Minkowski 正则化下总等周轮廓的演化。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明整个轮廓的单调性、等号分类和显式重参数化规律，并推出向等面积圆盘轮廓的一致收敛及尖锐不等式。
analysis.limitations: 研究对象为平面凸体和指定正则化；摘要未支持一般非凸体或高维的同样演化规律。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 将标量几何量的单调性提升到完整函数轮廓。
